message: 9223372036854775807 can't be held exactly as a number, so it's 9223372036854775808, as JSON tools read numbers (I-JSON)
The project has no place for these parts of info, so they aren't kept: termsOfService, contact, and license
Extensions aren't kept (2 places: x-logo and x-codegen-name)
Server URL variables were replaced with their defaults, since a project's servers are plain URLs; other values left out: region: us
OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect schemes are bearer token schemes in the app; their flows, URLs, and scopes are in each one's description: oauth
nullable: true without type has no effect in OpenAPI 3.0.3, so null isn't allowed in 1 place (/components/schemas/Book/properties/author). To allow it, put the schema in anyOf with {type: "null"}.
1 schema with nullable: true and an enum without null doesn't allow null, as OpenAPI 3.0.3 reads it (/components/schemas/Book/properties/status)
1 keyword beside a $ref was left out, since OpenAPI 3.0 ignores it there: maxLength (/components/schemas/BookAlias)
The app writes parameters with OpenAPI's default serialization, so style, explode, allowReserved, and allowEmptyValue aren't kept (1 parameter: genre (GET /books))
Header parameters named Accept, Content-Type, or Authorization were left out, since OpenAPI ignores them (1 parameter: Accept (GET /books))
Cookie parameters aren't kept, since endpoints have path, query, and header parameters (1 parameter: session (GET /books))
Links aren't kept (1 response: GET /books 200)
Callbacks aren't kept (1 operation, like POST /books)
1 example was left out, since the app keeps example values: from-file (POST /books request: its value is in another file, which the app never reads)
The app has no operation like this, so it was left out: TRACE /books/{bookId}
Scopes aren't kept (2 requirements, like oauth: books:delete and oauth: orders:write)
A body has one media type in the app, so 2 others were left out: image/jpeg (GET /books/{bookId}/cover 200) and application/x-www-form-urlencoded (POST /orders request)
1 operation ID was changed to letters, numbers, and underscores, unique, as the app takes them: authors.get-one → authors_get_one (GET /authors/{author-id})
Shared examples were copied into each response that uses them (1 example: author-tolkien)
Examples have no description in the app, so 1 description wasn't kept: hobbit (POST /books request)

2 tags (books and orders) weren't imported: OpenAPI tags group operations, and a project's pages are the screens that call them, so the endpoints start without pages. The Export tab lists them as unused until pages link them.
The document's external docs aren't kept
1 part of components.parameters that no operation uses isn't imported: Unused
